title.zh: 普查定律：成立者每步被列出时，不再成立的复现需要开始成立的复现，反之不然
title.en: The census law: where what holds is listed at each step, ceasing to be recurring needs coming to be recurring, and not conversely

claim.zh: 一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出（Listed），且每步可判定时，在任意晚的步有成员不再成立，就在任意晚的步有成员开始成立（Listed.coming_of_ceasing）。证明经过普查的平衡（census-balance）：不再成立复现时，从任一步 N 起其间不再成立的累加而超过 N 时的列表（recurring_accumulates），而终点的列表连同其间不再成立的恰是 N 时的列表连同其间开始成立的，所以其间有开始成立（Listed.coming_iff_excess）。P26 与 P27 曾直接由列表的长短证明（一次不再成立若此前没有开始成立，列表就变短，而列表不能永远变短）；P30 改由平衡证明，那一路线的三个引理不再被用到，从核心中去掉。普查就是活动的列出（Web.Census）：在普查之下，止息复现需要生起复现（Web.arising_of_ceasing）；读于世界：有普查、活动可判定的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现（World.arising_of_ceasing）。读于水平：所立者的普查（Web.StandingCensus）之下，不再作为条件而在的复现需要开始作为条件而在的复现（Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing）。读于依存：每步的依存被列出（Web.DependenceCensus）时，消解复现需要形成复现（Web.DependenceCensus.forming_of_dissolving）。反之不然：accretion 有普查，生起复现而从不止息；attrition 止息复现而没有任何生起，所以由这一规律，它没有普查（World.census_one_way）。逆命题在列表有界时成立，见 bounded-census-keeps-pace。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once (Listed), and the determination is decided at each step, members ceasing to hold at arbitrarily late steps need members coming to hold at arbitrarily late steps (Listed.coming_of_ceasing). The proof goes through the census balance (census-balance): with ceasing to be recurring, the ceasings from any step N on accumulate past the list at N (recurring_accumulates), while the list at the end with what ceased between is the list at N with what came between, so something comes to be between (Listed.coming_iff_excess). P26 and P27 proved it from the lengths of the lists directly (a ceasing not preceded by a coming to be shortens the list, which cannot shorten forever); P30 proves it through the balance, and the three lemmas of that route, no longer used, are removed from the core. A census is the listing of activity (Web.Census): under a census, ceasing recurring needs arising recurring (Web.arising_of_ceasing); read of worlds, in a world with a census whose activity is decided, ceasing recurs only where arising recurs (World.arising_of_ceasing). Read of standing: under a census of what stands (Web.StandingCensus), ceasing to stand recurring needs coming to stand recurring (Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing). Read of dependence: where the dependences of each step are listed (Web.DependenceCensus), dissolving recurring needs forming recurring (Web.DependenceCensus.forming_of_dissolving). Not conversely: accretion has a census, and arising recurs in it while nothing ever ceases; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census (World.census_one_way). The converse holds where the list is bounded; see bounded-census-keeps-pace. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 列出：每步成立者被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个成立；成员总共可以无限多。普查与所立者的普查是它读于活动与水平。
hypotheses.en: Listing: the members holding at each step are listed, each once, so finitely many hold at each step; there may be infinitely many members in all. The census and the census of what stands are this read of activity and of standing.

hypotheses.zh: 可判定：在纯核心中找出开始成立者要判定该规定；读于活动是活动可判定，读于水平自动成立（自然数的比较可判定）。这是表示的逻辑承诺，经典地总是成立。
hypotheses.en: Decidability: finding what comes to be in the pure core needs the determination decided; read of activity this is decided activity, read of standing it holds automatically (comparison of natural numbers is decidable). It is a logical commitment of the representation and classically always holds.

hypotheses.zh: census_one_way 是关于两个具体世界的陈述，不加前提。
hypotheses.en: census_one_way is a statement about two particular worlds, with no premise.

correspondence.zh: §26 的规律说，有限家族中开始成立复现恰当不再成立复现（coming_recurs_iff、Web.unceasing_iff）；关系项无限多时两者分离（Accretion、Attrition）。本结果说明分离只在一个方向上需要无限：每步只有有限多个成立时，不再成立复现仍需要开始成立复现，而开始成立复现不需要不再成立复现。这一规律对每步其成立者被列出的任何规定成立，活动与水平是它的两种读法，与 §26 中同一种变化读于活动、依存与水平相应。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在每步有限的展开中，没有只灭不生的不息；但可以有只生不灭的不息，只要成员总共无限多。这是活动与水平的读法，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）；它也不说止息是好的或坏的。本结果的一个用处是静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness 的 World.comes_to_rest）：那里生起停止由水平的规律给出，止息停止由本规律给出，所以体现只要求生起者，另要求活动的普查与所立者的普查，二者都不可少（World.rest_needs_census、World.rest_needs_standing）。
correspondence.en: Section 26's law says that in a finite family coming to be recurs exactly when ceasing to be does (coming_recurs_iff, Web.unceasing_iff); with infinitely many relata the two separate (Accretion, Attrition). This result shows that the separation needs infinity in one direction only: with finitely many holding at each step, recurring ceasing to be still needs recurring coming to be, while recurring coming to be does not need recurring ceasing to be. The law holds of any determination whose holders are listed at each step; activity and standing are two readings of it, matching section 26's one change read of activity, dependence and standing. The author's reading (an AI argument): in an unfolding finite at each step there is no endless ceasing without arising; there can be endless arising without ceasing, provided the members are infinitely many in all. This is a reading of activity and standing, arising and ceasing being names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference). It does not make ceasing good or bad. One use of the result is the rest theorem (World.comes_to_rest of continued-change-needs-openness): there arising stops by the law of standing and ceasing stops by this law, so of embodiment only whatever arises is needed, alongside a census of what is active and a census of what stands, neither of which can be dropped (World.rest_needs_census, World.rest_needs_standing).

detail.zh: 复用普查的平衡读于复现（Listed.coming_iff_excess、Listed.over_stretch），普查定律由它推出。
detail.en: Reuses the census balance read of recurrence (Listed.coming_iff_excess, Listed.over_stretch); the census law follows from it.

output.zh: 开始成立复现，恰当起点的列表长于某个后来的列表连同其间不再成立的。
output.en: Coming to be recurs exactly when the list at the start is longer than some later list with what ceased between.

input.zh: 不再成立复现时，其间不再成立的累加而超过起点的列表，所以开始成立复现。
input.en: With ceasing to be recurring, what ceases accumulates past the list at the start, so coming to be recurs.

detail.zh: 复用止息（Web.Ceases）、Accretion 与 Attrition 两个见证，以及在任意晚的步为正的量的累加（recurring_accumulates）。
detail.en: Reuses ceasing (Web.Ceases), the witnesses Accretion and Attrition, and the accumulation of a quantity positive at arbitrarily late steps (recurring_accumulates).

output.zh: 有限家族中生起复现恰当止息复现；关系项无限多时两者分离。
output.en: In a finite family arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; with infinitely many relata they separate.

input.zh: 每步有限时，止息复现仍需要生起复现。
input.en: Finite at each step, recurring ceasing still needs recurring arising.

detail.zh: 复用普查（Web.Census）。P30 之前另复用不重复列表的长度比较（length_le_of_sub）与列表上的判定（search）。
detail.en: Reuses the census (Web.Census). Before P30 it also reused the length comparison of lists without repetition (length_le_of_sub) and search over a list (search).

output.zh: 普查与列表工具；普查无界地增长使生成不息。
output.en: The census and list tools; a census growing without bound makes generation unceasing.

input.zh: 普查之下，止息复现需要生起复现。
input.en: Under a census, recurring ceasing needs recurring arising.

detail.en: Reuses the census of a world (World.Counted).

output.zh: 普查是世界的前提，有限世界有普查。
output.en: A census is a premise of worlds, and a finite world has one.

input.zh: 有普查的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现。
input.en: In a world with a census, recurring ceasing comes with recurring arising.

detail.zh: 复用世界、生起复现与止息复现、accretion 与 attrition 及其分离（separate）。
detail.en: Reuses worlds, arising and ceasing recurring, accretion and attrition and their separation (separate).

output.zh: 关系项无限多时，生起复现与止息复现可以各自出现。
output.en: With infinitely many relata, arising and ceasing can each recur without the other.

input.zh: attrition 没有普查由本规律推出。
input.en: That attrition has no census follows from this law.

detail.zh: 逆命题：列表有界时，开始成立复现也需要不再成立复现，两者同步。
detail.en: The converse: where the list is bounded, recurring coming to be also needs recurring ceasing to be, and the two recur together.

detail.zh: 本规律由它推出（P30）；比率形式：任一段步上，不再成立比开始成立多出的不超过起点的列表。
detail.en: This law follows from it (P30); the form with rates: over any stretch, ceasings exceed comings by at most the list at the start.

detail.zh: 静止定理用本规律使止息停止，所以只要求生起者体现。
detail.en: The rest theorem uses this law to stop ceasing, so only whatever arises needs to be embodied.

detail.zh: 计划 P26：带普查前提的活动规律；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P26: a law of activity with a census as its premise; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: accretion：有普查，生起复现而从不止息，所以逆命题不成立；attrition：止息复现而没有生起，没有普查，所以普查不可少。
detail.en: accretion: a census, arising recurring, nothing ever ceasing, so the converse fails; attrition: ceasing recurring with nothing arising and no census, so the census is needed.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与每步有限的成立者陈述；要求规定可判定（逻辑承诺）；不说哪个成员开始成立，也不说开始成立与不再成立有因果关联：本规律是计数，不是机制；复现不给出频率；不评价生起或止息；名称由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and members finitely many at each step; needs the determination decided (a logical commitment); says neither which member comes to be nor that coming to be and ceasing to be are causally linked: the law is a count, not a mechanism; recurrence gives no frequency; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; names are Ren's to choose.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261010T145237.259199Z）：Becoming.Population 的 112 项定理（P27 把 P26 的 Web.arises_or_kept、arises_or_fewer、arises_within 推广为 Listed.comes_or_held、comes_or_fewer、comes_within、coming_of_ceasing，Web.arising_of_ceasing 为其活动读法；P30 改由平衡证明 coming_of_ceasing，去掉 comes_or_held、comes_or_fewer、comes_within，它们由回执 20261009T163512.365801Z 检查过）与 Becoming.Openness 的 76 项定理（含 World.arising_of_ceasing、Accretion.census、World.census_one_way 与 P27 新增的 Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing）全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 34 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 1540 项定理／2426 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261010T145910.464504Z 通过。P26 版本的回执为 20261009T135303.461724Z。作者反审见整合文档 §35、§36、§37 与 §40，尚无独立反审。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 36 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。第十一次独立审查（BECOMING-P25B-P29-REVIEW.md）接受其数学，所提更正在整合文档 §42 处理，这些更正尚未再经独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261010T145237.259199Z): the 112 theorems of Becoming.Population (P27 generalizes P26's Web.arises_or_kept, arises_or_fewer and arises_within to Listed.comes_or_held, comes_or_fewer, comes_within and coming_of_ceasing, with Web.arising_of_ceasing their reading of activity; P30 proves coming_of_ceasing through the balance and removes comes_or_held, comes_or_fewer and comes_within, which receipt 20261009T163512.365801Z checked) and the 76 theorems of Becoming.Openness (including World.arising_of_ceasing, Accretion.census, World.census_one_way and, new in P27, Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing) all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 34 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1540 theorems/2426 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261010T145910.464504Z passed. The P26 version's receipt is 20261009T135303.461724Z. The author's counterreview is in §35, §36, §37 and §40 of the integration note; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 36 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The eleventh independent review (BECOMING-P25B-P29-REVIEW.md) accepts its mathematics, and its corrections are handled in §42 of the integration note; those corrections are not yet independently reviewed.
